notes.title: Bullet: Surge is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]🎉 [b]Bullet: Surge is out now![/b][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce the release of [b]Bullet: Surge[/b], the real-time digital adaptation of the critically acclaimed puzzle-shooter board game [b]Bullet[/b] by Level99.[/p][p]You’ve seen the teasers, followed the updates, and some of you even jumped into the demo. Now it’s time to dive into the [b]real-time chaos[/b] and see the full game come to life![/p][p][/p][p]💥 [b]Available now on Steam[/b]: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830200/Bullet_Surge/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]🧠 In [b]Bullet: Surge[/b], you’ll dodge bullets with some fast-paced puzzle solving, and battle against a cast of powerful heroines—all in real time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Key Features[/b]
🧩 Fast-paced real-time puzzle mechanics
⚔️ Battle iconic heroines with unique abilities
🧠 Solo and Online PvP modes
🎨 Beautiful art and animations[/p][p]
♟️ Included: the original board game Score Attack for a slower-paced tactical experience![/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’re a veteran of the tabletop original or totally new to Bullet, we can’t wait for you to experience the chaos and fun of [b]Bullet: Surge[/b].[/p][p]📣 Share your thoughts, gameplay clips, and favorite heroines with us![/p][p]— Cerbere Games[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Trailer
notes.content:
The wait is over—our brand new trailer for Bullet: Surge is officially live! 💥

And yes... it finally reveals the release date!

[previewyoutube=BQGh775iZs4;full][/previewyoutube]

🗓️ Mark your calendars and get ready to dodge, shoot, and survive in style!

✨ Not only is there a new trailer, but we also revamped the tutorial—perfect for new players and veterans !

Let us know what you think of the trailer, and don't forget to share it with your bullet-dodging crew!

notes.title: Character Gameplay Peek: Si Yu Xiao
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=yM5IeqhrL-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

She is a complex heroine who doesn't have any bullet movement action! However, she takes matters into her own hands: she's moving directly in the grid, physically pushing bullets into other bullets to destroy them all!

Si Yu will join the other heroines in battle as a DLC character.

Sorry for being so quiet these days, the game is still very much planned to release and to get regular updates after that :) We hope to be able to give you more news soon!

notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility and French localization!

notes.title: Major update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

[previewyoutube=8Z4hqwvk2yE;full][/previewyoutube]

Once again, the Bullet: Surge Demo is getting a huge update!
Apart from many, many visual and quality of life changes, you will find quite a few gameplay updates that we think you will love:

[list]
[*] Rie is playable and she is awesome 🥳
[*] Young-Ja is changed to better fit in the new engine and she feels great 🔥
[*] Controller support 🎮
[*] Classic Score Attack is available with the board game’s original rules 🤯
[/list]

Online mode’s development is done. It’s not in the demo yet but we will try to make it playable in time-limited events in the future.  

The Demo also gets its own Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021200/Bullet_Surge_Demo/, where you can leave reviews.
It would mean a lot to us and for the future of the game if you could leave a review if you liked the game! 🙏 

Have fun!

notes.title: New mechanics and a much more welcoming tutorial
notes.content:
Once again, we made a big gameplay update to the Bullet: Surge demo!
[list]
[*]You can now ask for single bullets from the next burst, one by one, enabling even more tactical decisions
[*]A new mechanic: Bullet Time now enables you to temporarily slow time down, and clear bullets out of the way at the very last millisecond
[/list]

[previewyoutube=stszI-W-lSY;full][/previewyoutube]

There's also a brand new Tutorial that should be much more welcoming to players who have no previous knowledge of Bullet 😄 so don't hesitate to share the demo to your friends!

notes.title: A major tactical update!
notes.content:
Thanks to all the feedback we got for the demo, we are able to present you with a new version of Bullet: Surge!

[previewyoutube=OGWTXbT6tPc;full][/previewyoutube]

Here comes a series of changes that makes the game even more tactical and fun, discover them right now by playing the demo!

- No more free patterns!
- Bursts of bullets?!
- A new draw action?!!

And much more! You can also practice playing the game without the timer.
Come and discuss it with us on the Cerbere Games Discord!

notes.title: Playable demo! Steam Next Fest and Mariel Martin gameplay peek!
notes.content:
You will be able to play the Bullet: Surge demo during Steam Next Fest, starting on Monday!
Share it with your friends and your favorite streamers, let's see who gets the best score!

[previewyoutube=0heP_1UCWjU;full][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038939/4931c43d3aa093340b07cbda4b27ab70696f3ecb.png[/img][/previewyoutube]

Mariel is literally present in your grid! Her special token acts as an extremely mobile bullet; use it to complete your patterns or directly clear bullets next to it. She can also send bullets sliding until they hit other bullets. A hard character to master for sure, but so rewarding!

notes.title: Character gameplay peek: Adelheid Beckenbauer
notes.content:
Adelheid practices Musical Alchemy – the manifestation of magical powers via sound.

[previewyoutube=OClVIV3PAyk;full][/previewyoutube]

Her patterns are powerful but have a lot of color requirements, making them hard to use. Thankfully, she can transform bullets into Notes, special bullets that match all colors! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038939/169972bd418b9fcb9b9675334d2086749936f97b.gif[/img]

Will you keep the Notes in your grid to place future patterns, or will you clear them? Musical Alchemy is not easy!

notes.title: Character gameplay peek: Young-Ja Kim
notes.content:
Young-Ja is a ghost who loves to play pranks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038939/dcfe9dc77f41cfb25f5f5546928175aab6c13091.png[/img]

She doesn't clear bullets directly. Instead, she can push bullets in the direction indicated by the arrows on her patterns. Push bullets out of the grid, and they are cleared!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038939/787d0e21b51ab35da15baeaebeae33b31123c417.gif[/img]

Try to keep your hand full of patterns and maximise the use of her best patterns: Banshee Wail, Headbanger and Wake the Dead!

https://youtu.be/o_34GO4qUdw
